lead: Tilt-shift photo of a toy army diorama, olive drab and khaki, soft green light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for greensteelcommander.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen greensteelcommander-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish greensteelcommander-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: ground
images.prompt: A military base on green hills, with a rocket launch tower far in the distance.

images.name: commander
images.prompt: A commander figure standing over a sand table map covered in small tank models.

images.name: rivals
images.prompt: Two opposing toy tank columns facing each other across a river valley.

images.name: turn
images.prompt: A column of small tanks rolling along a dirt road through a forest.

images.name: mission
images.prompt: A small flag planted on a hilltop bunker, tanks gathered around it.

images.name: universe
images.prompt: A wide valley with several small bases connected by roads, seen from high above.

images.name: evening
images.prompt: A quiet military base at dusk, lights coming on, tanks parked in neat rows.

images.name: column
images.prompt: Tanks and trucks moving in a neat wedge formation across an open field.

images.name: build
images.prompt: Construction vehicles and cranes building a concrete wall around a base.

images.name: fuel
images.prompt: A convoy of fuel trucks driving along a winding mountain road.
